description: Renovate is the only dependency updater in this repo (see .github/ADMIN_SETUP.md — Dependabot stays alerts/security-only). Three scoped jobs, each carved out of the blanket `enabled: false` default below: (1) the LLM e2e harness's pinned Claude Code CLI version, tracking npm's `stable` dist-tag, deliberately lagged from `latest` — see test/e2e-llm/README.md for the bump procedure; (2) Go module updates across every go.mod in the repo (root, test/e2e-common/broker-driver, test/e2e-basic-mcp/agent — Renovate finds all three on its own, no per-directory config needed), grouped into one minor/patch PR and one major PR to keep volume down; (3) GitHub Actions version updates across all workflow files, grouped into a single PR. Top-level `commitBody` carries the DCO sign-off that the `DCO sign-off` CI gate requires — this is why Renovate covers Go and Actions too rather than a second updater (Dependabot) being added: its commit-message config has no field for a trailer, so its commits can never satisfy that gate. `commitBody` is top-level rather than per-rule so it also covers lock-file maintenance and config-migration branches. The gate exempts nobody: an author-name exemption would be forgeable with `git commit --author`. The address must match the identity Renovate commits under (the hosted GitHub App uses this one), otherwise its PRs go red on the gate — the fix is to correct the address here, never to exempt the bot.

prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `./run-all.sh` twice from `test/e2e-llm/` against the candidate version, confirm 16/16 pass both times. See the README's bump procedure.
